content:
Since the iPhone Duo was unveiled, the concept of having all major interface navigation elements accessible by thumb has been very appealing. Apple redefined smartphone navigation with the iPhone Duo's outer screen, and now every smartphone with its buttons on the top feels oddly out of place.

Everyone misses the days of smaller phones, mainly because every function was more within reach back then. The downside, of course, was the rather small screen, and the way content is displayed today is a far cry from those days.

The iPhone Duo solves both problems at once, offering a reasonably sized rectangular viewing area on the left, with a dock and navigation area on the right. You get a large-screen viewing experience while everything remains within the reach of your thumb.

Ever since Apple showed off this design, many enthusiasts have raised the concept of an 'iPhone Solo' — with the same screen size as the iPhone Duo, but without the folding design.

Although I doubt Apple will release this product, I do think it's a rather interesting idea, and depending on the market response to the iPhone Duo, it might become a reality in the future. Looking back, the current smartphone form factor was actually formed by accident. We once used 16:9 screens, then decided to eliminate all bezels and the Home button, and phones turned into these elongated, awkward-to-use devices.

The iPhone Duo reimagines what a smartphone should look like. Apple didn't simply port the standard iOS system onto the outer screen — they redesigned it for the optimal experience, and now I actually envy iPhone Duo users for having a phone that fits so well in the hand.

Top comment posted by Tony D

I actually like the Duo's screen layout. It would be great if you could choose to have the dock vertically on the side on a regular iPhone. The Duo's Control Centre design is also quite thoughtful.

We'll have to see how things develop. If the response to the Duo's outer screen is positive, an iPhone Solo could become a reality at any time.

What do you think of the iPhone Solo concept? Would you consider buying one? Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments.
